about.title: About CareBridge
about.subtitle: Connecting patients with their healthcare
about.description: CareBridge is a modern healthcare patient portal that empowers patients to manage their health information, appointments, and communications with their care team — all in one secure place.
about.feature1Desc: View your health information anytime, on any device.
about.feature2Desc: Built with HIPAA-aligned security practices to protect your data.
about.feature3Desc: Stay connected with your entire healthcare team in one place.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

notice.title: HIPAA Compliance Notice
notice.subtitle: Required before accessing protected health information
notice.bodyEnd: governed by the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA).
notice.rule1: Access only the minimum information necessary for your current task.
notice.rule2: Do not share, copy, or disclose PHI to unauthorized individuals.
notice.rule3: All actions you take are recorded in a HIPAA-compliant audit log.
notice.rule4: Your session will automatically expire after 15 minutes of inactivity.
notice.rule5: Report any suspected breach immediately to your compliance officer.
notice.disclaimer: Unauthorized access or disclosure of PHI is a federal violation subject to civil and criminal penalties.
notice.ctaButton: I acknowledge and agree to handle PHI responsibly

idleWarning.title: Session Expiring
idleWarning.subtitle: HIPAA auto-logout policy
idleWarning.body: You have been inactive. Your session will automatically end in {{time}} to protect patient health information.
idleWarning.ctaButton: I’m still here — keep me signed in
